properties.title: Riverine flood hazard – tile N70 W20
properties.description: A fluvial or riverine flood is a rise, usually brief, in the water level of a stream or water body to a peak from which the water level recedes at a slower rate.
properties.GCHD:notes: JRC currently has 90m and plans to release 30 m in the coming years which could be useful for sub-national and localized analysis in the future - also includes SSP based projections. CCRI 2021 used GAR 2015 which is quite outdated. GRID 2023 has some inconsistencies (comment from CCRI-DRM team). WRI is also a good alternative with projections - but yet to identify the future update frequencies and resolutions; it might also be good to align with INFORM data sources. Highest return period chosen to capture the maximum exposure.
